brief.name: Skill Swap
brief.summary: A private team workspace for reusable AI skills and plugins. Individual contributions become shared capability through a clear library, independent review and approved releases. The promise is: Your team's know-how, ready to use. The visual identity is warm and editorial. The dimensional logo MUST be built from layered heavyweight paper or card, with broad geometric pieces, controlled folds, substantial thickness, visible edges and restrained fiber texture. Explore three distinct territories: joined modules, a folded shared object, and parts framing an open shared space.
brief.audience: Teammates with mixed technical confidence, including newcomers discovering and using AI skills; Builders and trusted approvers maintain the shared library.
brief.intended_appearance: Warm editorial layered heavyweight matte paper and card, controlled folds, visible substantial edges and restrained fiber texture
avoid: Any non-paper material including ceramic, porcelain, metal, rubber, glass, wax or clay
A badge, medallion, backing disc, enclosing border or backing plate
Generic AI sparkles, chain links or recycling arrows
Slack hashtag or Dropbox diamond-box topology
Cohere cell cluster and Miro chevrons
Fine text or hairline geometry inside the symbol
Confusing peer-to-peer skill barter with a team AI skills library

before_intent.brand_geometry: Two broad card uprights with steep outward-folded edges stand above a low terracotta shelf. Pale laminated cores show at the cut edges. The central space stays open across the entire top, replacing the earlier near-enclosing upper tips.

before_intent.material_construction: Each card part has a 0.024-unit pale paper core between two 0.006-unit colored skins. Watertight meshes meet at continuous fold lines. Outer upright returns turn sharply away from the open center; the shelf wings rise along one score. Three separate assemblies retain visible seams without a backing plate.

inspection.json.observations: Three laminated paper assemblies surround a central open space. Two upright green leaves fold outward; the terracotta lower assembly bends at both shoulders. Thin pale cores are visible at the edges. There is no backing plate or enclosing border. The pale green right leaf renders nearly white; material credibility, small-size readability and brand specificity still need independent review.
inspection.json.user_feedback: Open paper structures are allowed, without an enclosing border or backing plate. No artistic approval supplied.

visually_distinct.instructions: Do `before` and `after` explore genuinely different symbol geometry or material-specific construction? Text labels, descriptions, color/material swaps, camera, sampling or finish alone do not count. Compare images with their own construction intents.

criteria.true: Meaningfully distinct visual alternatives in symbol or construction are visible.
criteria.false: Essentially the same geometry/idea, or only finish/text/technical settings differ.

critique_resolved.instructions: Does `after` visibly address the concrete critique in `prior_critique` relative to its intended appearance and user direction? If no defect was asserted, does it succeed as its own deliberate alternative? A glossier or rounder finish is not automatically better. Preserve uncertainty when the images cannot establish resolution.

criteria.true: The revision resolves the stated issue, or succeeds as a deliberate alternative with no invented defect.
criteria.false: The concrete critique persists or cannot be evaluated from the images.
